about_the_game:
In a world filled with dangerous dungeons and fearsome monsters, the bravest raiders venture forth to battle, gathering rare materials and treasures. As a guild shop owner, your role isn’t just to fight, but to trade, craft, and collect. Manage your own shop, sell precious materials, and craft gear to support the raiders in their perilous quests while growing your business into the supply hub for raiders.

While you may not wield a sword yourself, your success depends on the raiders who venture into dungeons for valuable loot. Establish partnerships with skilled raiders, commission expeditions, and ensure a steady flow of rare items into your shop. The deeper the dungeon, the greater the challenge, but also the better the rewards.

Your shop is the cornerstone of the adventuring world, supplying essential materials for crafting and trade. Supply materials such as minerals, woods, and rare items from dungeon raids. Carefully manage your inventory, ensuring a balance between common and high-value materials to attract customers of all kinds. Additionally, convert the value of raw materials into the gear that raiders need through the crafting process. The success of your store depends on your ability to restock efficiently, set strategic prices, and meet market demand.


Transform raw materials into high-quality gear that raiders need through crafting. With the right materials, you can craft swords, armor, shields, and helmets to sell in your shop. Manage your resources wisely, decide whether to sell raw materials directly or use them to craft high-value gear that attracts more raiders. A well-stocked shop with top-tier equipment will become the go-to destination for raiders seeking the best gear.

Supply the rarest materials, craft powerful gear, and build a shop that every raiders relies on. Master the market, refine your crafting, and become the top supplier of legendary materials. The fate of your business is in your hands!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 7700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Supply materials, craft powerful gears, and run a guild shop. Support guild dungeon conquests and become the top supplier for raiders. Combine all your guild members' skills to conquer dungeons and seize rare materials from monsters!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
